name: org_health
description: C7a (brief 47 scenario 5 at island scale, SVC-HEAL-2, SVC-ACC-4): two factions of eight founding adults; work is dangerous (a raid stand-in: forage and gather hazards 20% per full work day, injuries of 100-300 that kill at 300 per mille a day while above 300 (a visible wound)), so wounds are common. One adult per faction knows the healing practice (skill 300) and its faction believes it a healer (Orgs.C7.StartHealers = 1). Nothing scripted, no player: the wounded ask by gesture, healers see signs, gather herbs at root patches, treat within reach; a healer who treated three people informally may found a practice. Control: org_health_nohealer. 20 sim days. Civ is on only for the shared skill store (R42); C1 building and C3 hiring are off (Civ.C1.BuildEnabled = 0, Civ.C3.HireEnabled = 0) so the evidence is about healing alone.
